# TypeSafeAI Community Notes

> Unofficial community static notes, not the official TypeSafe AI blog. No provider keys or package install are required.

Keep semantic HTML, stable article anchors, source-backed claims and the unofficial notice. Do not invent a production domain, license, author, benchmark, or deployed image. Run the dependency-free static tests and inspect narrow layouts for visual changes. This navigation does not override repository instructions or authorize external actions.
